entities.name: Shade
entities.description: Shadowy ghosts of dead people who linger on earth, typically employed by evil wizards wielding black mana.

entities.name: Frozen Shade
entities.description: Shades inhabiting regions of Dominaria, often enslaved by powerful sorcerers.

entities.name: Caliphear the Nightmare
entities.description: Sorcerer whose lands in the Great Salt Marshes were protected by Frozen Shades.

entities.name: Coldraith
entities.description: Wizard whose magic made the swamps barren.

entities.name: Aldon
entities.description: Summoned a Frozen Shade with a dark amulet and was persuaded to attack Dreygar's Castle.

entities.name: Dreygar
entities.description: Owner of Dreygar's Castle, killed when Aldon attacked.

entities.name: Rimewind Necromancers
entities.description: Necromancers who created Chilling Shades from souls trapped in mystical blizzards.

entities.name: Belzenlok's Cabal
entities.description: Cabal served by dread shades known as remnants.

entities.name: Legion of Dusk
entities.description: Ixalan faction whose Condemners include Shade-Binders.

entities.name: House Dimir
entities.description: Ravnican guild employing shades as servants, spies and protectors.

entities.name: Cult of Rakdos
entities.description: Ravnican guild employing shades as servants, spies and protectors.

entities.name: Ihsan's Shade
entities.description: An infamous Shade on Ulgrotha created by Baron Sengir.

events.summary: Frozen Shades guarding Caliphear's lands are defeated by goblins and Shanodin Dryads after Coldraith's magic makes the swamps barren.
events.quote: These Shades were defeated by goblins and Shanodin Dryads

events.summary: Aldon summons a Frozen Shade with a dark amulet; it joins Dreygar in persuading him to attack Dreygar's Castle, and Dreygar is killed.
events.quote: When Dreygar was killed, the bog wraith remained as an advisor to Aldon.

events.summary: Baron Sengir creates Ihsan's Shade on Ulgrotha.

relations.quote: Some were used as protectors of Caliphear the Nightmare ’s lands

relations.note: dread shades known as remnants served the Cabal
